title: Two Heads Are Better Than One: Audio-Visual Speech Error Correction with Dual Hypotheses
abstract: arXiv:2510.13281v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a new paradigm for generative error correction (GER) framework in audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) that reasons over modality-specific evidences directly in the language space. Our framework, DualHyp, empowers a large language model (LLM) to compose independent N-best hypotheses from separate automatic speech recognition (ASR) and visual speech recognition (VSR) models. To maximize the effectiveness of DualHyp, we further introduce RelPrompt, a noise-aware guidance mechanism that provides modality-grounded prompts to the LLM. RelPrompt offers the temporal reliability of each modality stream, guiding the model to dynamically switch its focus between ASR and VSR hypotheses for an accurate correction. Under various corruption scenarios, our framework attains up to 57.7% error rate gain on the LRS2 benchmark over standard ASR baseline, contrary to single-stream GER approaches that achieve only 10% gain.

translated_title: 三个臭皮匠顶个诸葛亮：基于双假设的视听语音纠错
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种面向视听语音识别（AVSR）的生成式错误纠正（GER）框架的新范式，该范式直接在语言空间中对各模态特有的证据进行推理。我们的框架 DualHyp 使大语言模型（LLM）能够整合来自独立的自动语音识别（ASR）模型与视觉语音识别（VSR）模型的各自独立的 N-best 假设列表。为了最大化 DualHyp 的效果，我们进一步提出了 RelPrompt，这是一种噪声感知的引导机制，可为 LLM 提供基于模态的提示。RelPrompt 提供各模态流随时间的可靠性信息，引导模型在 ASR 和 VSR 假设之间动态切换关注焦点，从而实现更准确的纠正。在各种损坏场景下，我们的框架在 LRS2 基准上相比标准 ASR 基线实现了高达 57.7% 的错误率下降，而单流 GER 方法仅能获得约 10% 的提升。
tldr: 该论文提出 DualHyp 视听语音纠错框架，让大语言模型在语言空间中联合推理 ASR 与 VSR 双路的独立 N-best 假设，并通过噪声感知的 RelPrompt 机制动态切换模态关注焦点，在 LRS2 基准上实现高达 57.7% 的错误率下降，远超单流方法的 10%。
en_tdlr: DualHyp enables an LLM to perform generative error correction by reasoning over independent N-best hypotheses from both ASR and VSR streams, with a noise-aware RelPrompt mechanism that dynamically shifts focus between modalities, achieving up to 57.7% error rate reduction on LRS2 compared to only 10% for single-stream approaches.
